Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly extract and synthesize information from the retrieved search results. In Step 2, the search results explicitly displayed conflicting information: one snippet stated Allan Kroeker was born in "Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada," while another snippet (from IMDb) clearly stated he "grew up in Winnipeg" and was a "Canadian film... director." Despite this direct contradiction visible in the viewport, the agent prematurely concluded the birthplace was Vancouver without verifying the discrepancy or prioritizing the more detailed biographical data from the IMDb source which often corrects or clarifies such details. This mirrors the error pattern of relying on unverified snippets and failing to cross-validate conflicting data before finalizing an answer.
